scenario_description: Baseline Week: A standard week with balanced ad spend and a small discount.
All-in on Facebook: Shift the entire $15k budget to Facebook.
All-in on Google: Shift the entire $15k budget to Google.
Test Optimal Discount: Apply the theoretical optimal discount of 15%.
Aggressive Discount: Push discount to 30% to see diminishing returns.
Premium Week (No Discount): Test a high-spend week with zero discount.
Influencer Lift (No Synergy): An influencer post with zero Facebook ad support.
Synergy Test: A high Facebook spend week with an influencer.
Control for Synergy Test: A high Facebook spend week without an influencer.
